_about: Per-frame canvas profiles for gfx.py `size --profile` and for hoi4-imagegen, which reads this file. One row per hoi4-imagegen family (40). The values are the vanilla sizes measured on HOI4 1.19.4.1 and every row cites its evidence. `accepted` lists every size treated as valid; `canvas` is the size for new art; `margin` is the minimum transparent margin in pixels for `size`; `frames` is the number of frames in a horizontal strip. A mod that settled other canvases overrides the rows in its own copy of this file (Chaos Redux keeps 94x86 focus, 64x64 idea and 32x32 decision icons) and hoi4-imagegen then reports the difference from vanilla. Rows named `focus`, `decision`, `idea`, `category`, `report`, `news`, `counter-large` and `counter-small` keep the names gfx.py reads (they map to the families focus, decision, idea_spirit, decision_category_icon, report_event, news_event, counter_large and counter_small); the other rows are named by family id. `off_size_level` is the gfx.py finding level for a focus, decision or idea frame outside `accepted`. gui_texture and super_event have no vanilla canvas, so a mod defines theirs. The family list is `.tools/gfx/family_ids.json`.

focus.source: Measured on HOI4 1.19.4.1 (focus_icon): 2884 textures in gfx/interface/goals::^(goal|focus|untitl); 100x88 is 2615 files (90.7 percent); next: 102x90: 28, 89x79: 20, 192x128: 17. GFX_focus_ is the majority sprite prefix and GFX_goal_ the original. Every vanilla focus has a _shine companion sprite. gfx.py reports a wrong size as an error and an accepted non-canvas size as a review item.

idea.source: Measured on HOI4 1.19.4.1 (idea_spirit_and_advisor): 2748 textures in gfx/interface/ideas::^idea_; 60x68 is 1102 files (40.1 percent); next: 65x67: 998, 64x64: 544, 62x70: 17. gfx.py applies this row to every idea picture, and spirits, industrial concerns and advisor cards share one folder, so it accepts all of their sizes: 60x68 and 62x70 spirits, 64x64 concerns and 65x67 advisor cards. hoi4-imagegen reads this row as idea_spirit; its idea_concern and advisor_card rows are exact.

idea_concern.source: Measured on HOI4 1.19.4.1 (idea_spirit_and_advisor): 2748 textures in gfx/interface/ideas::^idea_; 60x68 is 1102 files (40.1 percent); next: 65x67: 998, 64x64: 544, 62x70: 17. Industrial concerns and the four manufacturer categories in common/ideas are 64x64 (about 80 percent of their ideas); the dominant size of the shared idea folder is the spirit size.

modifier_stat_icon.source: Measured on HOI4 1.19.4.1 (stat_modifier_tooltip_icon): 47 textures in gfx/interface/modifiers; 30x20 is 32 files (68.1 percent); next: 26x21: 2, 26x18: 1, 26x23: 1. Tooltip icons for modifiers (GFX_MODIFIER_* in vanilla).

gui_texture.source: Not measured in vanilla. General GUI textures have 856 distinct sizes in vanilla: the size comes from the consuming GUI element and the mod defines it here (canvas and accepted) or per request.

super_event.source: Not measured in vanilla. Super events have no vanilla texture: they are a mod pattern (GUI windows), so the mod defines the canvas here.
